name: All-Angles
intro: All-Angles Bench 包含 90 个真实多视角场景与 2,132 个三选一问答对，通过计数、属性、相对距离、相对方向、物体操作和相机姿态六类任务评估 MLLM 的跨视角对应与几何一致性，并用配对问题诊断预测不一致。
org: UC Berkeley, HKU, NYU, University of Oxford, UC Davis, TranscEngram, SLAI
build_method: 人工筛选多视角场景, GPT-4o生成五类问题, 相机姿态专用模板, 八名STEM博士首轮复核、交叉复核、定期随机抽检与配对质检
metric: 准确率, 配对一致性类别（CC/WW/IC）
task_type: 多视角三选一视觉问答
eval_feature: 多视角, 几何一致性, 跨视角对应
build_method_en: Human multi-view scene selection, GPT-4o authoring for five task types, a dedicated camera-pose template, and first-pass review, cross-checking, periodic random audits, and paired-question QC by eight STEM PhD annotators
intro_en: All-Angles Bench contains 2,132 three-option QA pairs over 90 real multi-view scenes. Six tasks—counting, attributes, relative distance, relative direction, object manipulation, and camera pose—test cross-view correspondence and geometric consistency, while paired questions diagnose prediction inconsistency.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.15280v2 §2.2, Figure 3, §3.1, Appendix §7.1–§7.3 and §8.1, plus the official project page https://danielchyeh.github.io/All-Angles-Bench/. Appendix §7.3 requires a pilot before formal annotation, a cross-check of every annotation by at least one other annotator, group discussion for disagreements, and periodic random review. Eight STEM PhD annotators apply those gates before the three-option single-answer contract, paired-question construction, and final QC; the release has 2,132 QA pairs and 85.3% paired coverage excluding counting. The dashed model-evaluation branch is outside construction: VLMEvalKit uses greedy decoding at temperature 0 and Qwen2.5-32B extracts an option letter before accuracy and CC/WW/IC analysis. The separate 250-question human subset excludes paired data.
